results.content: # Apple Preparing to Increase iPhone Prices. Apple is preparing to raise iPhone prices following similar moves from Samsung and Google, according to *Bloomberg*'s Mark Gurman. In the latest edition of his "Power On" newsletter, Gurman said that the iPhone faces the same memory and chip supply chain issues affecting Apple's other products, so a price increase "remains inevitable.". Matching that increase would put the iPhone 18 Pro's starting price at $1,199, up about 9% from the current iPhone 17 Pro's $1,099 starting price. As Google puts it, the feature will turn your spreadsheets in Google Sheets into custom, interactive "mini-apps.".
